answer.reason: The verse states what the flaming sword was placed to do, which goes beyond the summary's mention of its position.

clauses.english: was placed to keep the way of the tree of life
clauses.quote: a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life

doubts: The summary already says it was placed with the cherubim at the east of Eden; the clause adds only its purpose.
